raw.name: Vivarium
raw.description:
The Commons keeps its Python snakes in a vivarium. Each one is sealed in
an enclosure, safely separated from the vault where their food is stored.

Or so the keepers thought. One particularly sneaky snake slipped through
the GPG socket connecting its enclosure to the vault.

Run `/flag` and the vault will return an encrypted message. The public
key is available at `/flag.pub`; the rest is history.

Follow the snake and recover the plaintext flag.

> [!CONNECTION]
> https://vivarium-lblgay6n.challenge.2026.haruulzangi.mn
